worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.summary: Moves so fast it leaves mirror images in sync with the body; incoming attacks strike a mirror first, which takes the hit in the body's place and fades as it is worn down, while the body keeps a burst of speed. It adds no health or defence — it only redirects damage onto the images.
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.use.0: Leave images before focus fire, pulling damage onto them
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.use.1: Speed away from a pursuit while the images soak the hits
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.use.2: Buy a few seconds to reposition or withdraw
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.description: Moves fast to leave mirror images that absorb a total of %1$s of your maximum health in damage; blocked damage is drawn from that budget, and once it is spent the images vanish while any excess still reaches you.

Protection lasts %1$s; while it holds you move 12% faster and a Pokémon also gains 1 evasion stage. It absorbs damage only and does not block control effects or statuses; the images also fade when the duration ends or the effect is cleared.

Leaving the images takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The deploy is a choice: Swarm multiplies budget and duration by x1.25, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.2 cooldown; Swift multiplies budget and duration by x0.8, in exchange for -2 ticks wind-up, x0.75 cooldown and a burst of extra speed.
Swarm: x1.25 budget and x1.25 duration, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.2 cooldown — good for tanking a round when several enemies are on you. Swift: x0.8 budget and duration, in exchange for -2 ticks wind-up, x0.75 cooldown and a burst of extra speed — good for leaving images on the run.
The partner only considers leaving images while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for self-defence in melee, larger prepares from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to leave images.
